title: otel Feature Generator
description: Adds OpenTelemetry route tagging and a baseline Grafana dashboard to an existing HAPI FHIR server

project.description: Name of the Nx server project to add the feature to

serviceName.description: service.name resource attribute; defaults to the project name

dashboard.description: Write the baseline Grafana dashboard and its provisioning file under otel/grafana

compose.description: Write docker-compose.otel.yml with a local Grafana LGTM stack

serve.description: Enable nx serve --otel, which fetches and attaches the OpenTelemetry Java agent
